////										NPC IPS 									  ////
// Tags:                                              		  			  	  				//
//                                                    		  			      				//
// <P(ID)> 		= Which publisher owns the IP.      			  			  				//
// <G(ID)>		= Main genre of the IP.							              				//
// <SG(ID)>		= Sub genre of the IP.                                        				//
// <T(ID)> 		= Main topic of the IP.    						  		      				//
// <ST(ID)> 	= Sub topic of the IP.     					  		  		  				//
// <%(0-100)>	= What review score does the game get.                        				//
//				  The score <%> is always random between +10/-10.             				//
//				  The AI prioritizes IPs with high review more than others.   				//
// <Y(YEAR)>	= Minimum year of release.                                    				//
// <TG(0-4)>	= Target group used.                 		  		  	      				//
//					0 = Children                                              				//
//					1 = Teenagers                                             				//
//					2 = Adults                                                				//
//					3 = Seniors                                               				//
//					4 = All                                                					//
// <ROM>		= Roman Numbers for sequels.       						  					//
// <ARA>		= Arabic Numbers for sequels.								  				//
// <PL(ID)>		= Platform (For arcade & mobile games, the developer must be a publisher.)	//
// <PLSTATIC>	= Sequels have the same platform type of <PLx>.								//
// <EX>			= Exclusive game															//
// <MMO>		= Massively Multiplayer Online Game											//
// <F2P>		= Free-to-play Game															//
// <NOSPIN>		= No spin-offs allowed                 		  			      				//
//																							//
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
//Line 31 = ID 0
